comments.note: workspace.manager.test.ts: 'list WorkspaceInfo entries include all required fields' and 'create returns WorkspaceInfo with correct fields' do not assert Notes: ''. summary: Code review PASS — no blocking issues found.

Type design is idiomatic: Notes?: string on the storage type (ProjectWorkspace) allows backward-compat reads of pre-existing JSON files without a schema bump; Notes: string on the view type (WorkspaceInfo) eliminates null-checks for consumers. This pattern is correct.

The ?? '' nullish coalescing is the semantically precise operator here (distinguishes null/undefined from an intentionally empty string), and it is applied consistently across all 5 WorkspaceInfo factory sites in workspace.manager.ts.
create() hardcodes Notes: '' directly, which is correct — a freshly created workspace has no notes yet and no storage re-read is needed.

All 6 server test fixtures are correctly updated. WP scope note: the plan document listed src/storage/storage.types.ts as the location for ProjectWorkspace, but that file only defines BaseStore. The Developer correctly identified and modified the actual location (src/models/project/project.types.ts).
No Fix-Forward changes needed. One Documentation-Forward item recorded for the API surface doc.
